$comment: Bubble instant reactions (layered on top of the active state). Sounds: synthesized sine tones with exponential frequency sweep; 8 ms attack and exponential decay to duration end.

soundRules.volume: low; always respects system silent mode

tap.description: Plop: double blink, emits a small bubble, and wobbles whole body by 3%.

wobble.formula: w = A·sin(2π·f·t)·e^(−d·t); scaleX = 1 + w; scaleY = 1 − w
wobble.rule: Only as an instant reaction to touch. Never at rest or in transitions. Never local bends.

appear.description: Emerges from a single point; soap film spins fast then settles. No bounce.

celebrate.description: Gentle hop, smiling eyes, accelerated colors, and micro-bubble shower.

farewell.description: Smiles and floats upward while fading away. Bubble NEVER bursts.

thinkingRhythm.description: How the thinking choreography adapts to chat response latency.

rules.behavior: One full cycle of the choreography
Repeat cycle with 1 s pause between iterations
Interrupt and return to neutral within 0.6 s without completing cycle
